description: Ministry of Ports and Shipping - Merchant Shipping (Construction-Fire Protection, Fire-Detection and fire Extinction)) Regulation No. 03 of 2021
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Ports and Shipping under the Merchant Shipping Act, No. 52 of 1971. It establishes new legal/regulatory requirements for fire protection, detection, and extinction on ships, giving effect to international maritime safety conventions. The content focuses entirely on creating new regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories.
